services.name: All Courses
services.desc: Whether you’re new to boating or aiming to build handling skills, our Powerboating Programs offers a complete, flexible pathway for adults of all experience levels. Training is delivered by instructors using THNC’s fleet, giving students real-world experience on Toronto’s Inner Harbour and surrounding waterways. Start with Introduction to Power for a relaxed, hands-on first experience at the helm, or move directly into the Sail Canada Basic Power Course to earn an internationally recognized certification. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: Discover the joy of sailing with our Sail Canada-certified programs, designed to take you from your first time on the water to confidently skippering your own boat. If you’re simply curious to try sailing, our Introduction to Sailing offers a fun, two-hour on-water experience - no experience required. Those looking to earn certification can start directly with our Sail Canada Basic Cruising Course, where you’ll gain the skills and confidence to skipper keelboats up to 24 ft. Continue on to Intermediate Cruising, a five-day live-aboard adventure that prepares you for bareboat chartering and coastal sailing anywhere in the world. All courses are taught by Sail Canada-certified instructors -

services.name: Yacht Charters
services.desc: Set sail on Toronto’s iconic waterfront with our fleet of cruising yachts, ideal for relaxed outings and time on the water with friends or family. Our Niagara 35, Hunter 240, and Mirage 27s are classic, dependable boats that offer a comfortable and authentic sailing experience.These vessels are available to experienced sailors, or we can arrange a certified skipper for a more relaxed outing. To charter one of our yachts, prior sailing experience on comparable vessels is required. Please complete our online Boating Resume Form for review and approval before booking.
